messages:
incident-bot: ALERT P1 — elevated error rates observed on dedicated pool eu-west-2-pool-3. Metric: 5m 503+429 rate 21% (baseline <1%). Trigger: pool_qos_overthreshold. Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/4512349999
liz_oncall: taking pager — starting triage. Who's seeing customer errors?
support-jordan: ShipFast and MarketForge reporting timeouts and 429s since ~10:08Z. ShipFast: ~55% failures to /v1/generate. MarketForge: increased tail latency and a few 503s. I have customer tickets open.
eng-runtime: checked pool metrics — qlen spiked, gpu_mem ~99%, burst tokens at 0. Autoscaler blocked due to rapid failure gating. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:09:03Z pool=eu-west-2-pool-3 qlen=412 gpu_mem=99% autoscale=GATED reason=rapid_error_spike
```
eng-sre: FYI there was a concurrency-slice change earlier that reduced slice for pool-3 by 60% to stabilize cost. Could be compounding.
liz_oncall: immediate plan: 1) spill traffic to reserve-burst-02 for 20m 2) apply soft per-cust caps for the heaviest accounts 3) enable traffic-shaping to favor paid customers and disable non-essential features on free tier. Thoughts?
harsh_oncall: agree. I'll own the reserve handoff toggle. Liz, if you set the caps I'll watch for requeue/backpressure.
eng-runtime: to execute handoff:
```
ops-bot: /pool handoff --from eu-west-2-pool-3 --to reserve-burst-02 --mode spillover --duration 20m
```
ops-bot: Handoff initiated. Warm-up ETA ~65s. Expected +45% available capacity to pool-3.
liz_oncall: applying soft caps: ShipFast max_concurrency=10 (was 60), MarketForge max_concurrency=8 (was 40). Also toggling feature_flags.free_embed=false for this pool to reduce load.
eng-sre: caps applied. Also pushing traffic shape rule prioritizing "paid" tag: qos.priorities=[\"paid\",\"standard\",\"free\"]. Confirmed feature flag off for free embeddings on pool-3.
support-jordan: customer comms drafted: "We're seeing elevated errors and have temporarily applied rate limits and added capacity. We're monitoring and will update within 20 minutes." Sending now to ShipFast and MarketForge.
product-ana: please include expected ETA for full resolution and note any degraded features (embeddings off for free tier).
eng-runtime: reserve-burst-02 warmed. Observability: pool-3 5m error rate 21% -> 7% over ~90s, overall tail latency improving. Queue length trending down.
liz_oncall: good. Monitor for 20m. If stable at T+15 we retract caps and handoff. Harsh, I'll handoff to you at 10:30Z for overnight watch.
harsh_oncall: acknowledged. During handoff watch autoscale_gating and recent concurrency rollback flag. If we see another spike, open infra-eng and extend reserve by 30m.
support-jordan: ShipFast acknowledged and throttled some background jobs; they reported immediate improvement on their side.
customer-ops: flagged ShipFast as high-touch and scheduling a post-incident sync tomorrow to review traffic patterns and runbook.
liz_oncall: marking pager as mitigated for now — reserve pool + caps reduced error rate. Keeping thread open until handoff. Runbook ref: https://runbooks.redwood/pool-spillover
ops-bot: Incident 4512349999 -> status: partial_mitigated. Next update due by 10:30Z.
harsh_oncall: handoff noted. I'll post a final summary after 30m observation including mitigation timeline, customer impact summary, and follow-ups (config rollback review, runbook updates).
